label: Heartbreak
lyrics: Broken, lost, lonely in the dark. Tears falling, hurt so deep, pain that never fades. Cold and empty, dead inside, sad goodbye.

label: Anger
lyrics: Hate burning, rage in my chest, angry at the world. Hurt and pain and dark, scream and shout and break it all.

label: Despair
lyrics: Lost in the dark, broken and dead, suffer in the cold. Tears and pain, empty heart, nightmare without end, sad sad sad.

label: Fear
lyrics: Fear and nightmare crawling close, dark hell rising. Cold sweat, lonely, broken, afraid to breathe. Empty silence, lost inside.

label: Mourning
lyrics: Death and tears and goodbye. Cold body, dead heart, lost forever. Sad lonely empty world, broken without you, pain that stays.

label: Rage
lyrics: Angry, angry, angry, rage burns hot, hate fills the room. Scream and break, hurt and pain, dark and dead inside.

label: Isolation
lyrics: Lonely night, cold room, empty bed. Lost, broken, sad and tired. Tears in the dark, nightmare alone, no one to hold.

label: Anxiety
lyrics: Fear creeping, dark thoughts, nightmare won't stop. Cold hands, broken sleep, lost and empty. Pain and dread, hell of the mind.

label: Bitter
lyrics: Hate everything, angry world, dark heart. Hurt me again, pain on pain, dead to it all. Cold rage, broken trust, lost cause.

label: Hopeless
lyrics: Empty, empty, empty, sad sad sad. Broken dreams, dead future, lost and cold. Pain and tears, lonely dark, suffer endless.
